# Medhelp Folding Shower Chair for Inside Shower, Stainless Steel Foldable Shower Stool, 400lbs Portable Folding Shower Seat for Travel, Anti-Slip Small Shower Chair for Elderly Disabled Injured, White
Brand: Medhelp
Category: Bath & Shower Aids > Bath & Shower Safety Seating & Transfer Benches

## Features
Stainless Steel; SAVE SMART WITH OUR FSA & HSA ELIGIBLE PRODUCTS Maximize your health and budget with our selection of FSA and HSA eligible products! By using your Flexible Spending Account (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA), you can save money while investing in your health. Enjoy the peace of mind that comes with knowing you’re making smart financial choices; UPGRADED HEAVY-DUTY STAINLESS STEEL - Medhelp folding shower seat is made from heavy-duty stainless steel, providing exceptional strength and corrosion resistance. Unlike aluminum foldable shower stool, our bath chair offers superior stability, reducing shaking by 90% and eliminating any bending, supporting up to 400 pounds. Medhelp shower chair for inside shower is designed for individuals of all ages with limited mobility, making it ideal for daily use; FOLDABLE DESIGN & TOOL-FREE ASSEMBLY - Medhelp folding shower chair provides convenience and portability with its compact, foldable design. This portable shower chair for travel offers reliable support and stability during bathing, and it can be easily folded when not in use. The one-second folding mechanism saves valuable bathroom space and makes it ideal for travel. Just follow the instructions, and your small shower stool will be ready in no time; ERGONOMICALLY CONTOURED SEAT DESIGN - Experience unparalleled comfort and support with our contoured shower chair seat. Designed with your safety in mind, the textured surface ensures a secure grip, significantly reducing the risk of slipping or sliding. Strategically placed drainage holes facilitate efficient water drainage, keeping the shower seat dry. Additionally, the built-in side handles make maneuvering and maintaining balance effortless while using the collapsible shower stool; WIDENED ANTI-SLIP FEET CAPS FOR STABILITY - Medhelp shower chair for elderly and disabled feature widened anti-slip rubber feet, providing a secure and stable base to prevent potential accidents or slips while showering. The non-slip foot caps ensure that the shower chair for inside tub remains firmly in place within the bathtub or shower stall, offering you peace of mind and safety during your bathroom experience; ADDED SAFETY, COMFORT & VALUE - Medhelp waterproof foldable shower chair is equipped with a comfortable 8 mm thick EVA cushion that is both waterproof and odor-resistant. Effortlessly clean those hard-to-reach spots with the included long-handled shower loofah. Additionally, the mesh shower bag with a convenient hanger ensures your shower essentials are always within reach. Together, these features provide peace of mind during your daily shower routine

## Specifications
Color: White; Material Type: Stainless Steel; Item Weight: 2.6 Kilograms; Minimum Height: 17.7 Inches; Seat Depth: 11 inches

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 4.4 from 1062 reviews.
Top review: Needed a shower chair due to having surgery. Found this one, and cannot say enough good things about it!It is adjustable to allow for your height, which is great. The assembly was easy, too. Having the braces at the sides is also amazing. I didn’t think I would need them, but they turned out to be so nice to have.The seat drains well, and having the section in front that is cut out to allow for better access and ease when washing is ingenious. It came with a small pad that you could opt to adhere to the seat, but my husband and I both decided not to use it. (If needed, I would simply place a washcloth or a small hand towel on the seat instead.)It is sturdy, but not so heavy that you cannot lift or move it. The non-slip sections on the ends of the legs definitely do their job.For reference, we have a split shower and tub set up in our bathroom. Our walk in shower is made for a single person and is not very large. This chair fit easily in it without any issues. (We have a shower head that is able to be pulled down and hand held, which also made the set up easy.) After use, we simply sprayed it down with a disinfectant, rinsed it, and allowed it to air dry. It was also easy enough for us to pull out of the shower and use for me to sit on while doing my hair and dressing after showering. It also fits easily in our bathtubs, and it is not showing any signs of rust.While I did not want to have a shower chair, I am certainly glad that I had one, especially in the first few weeks post-op. And I am quite pleased with this particular chair with the size of it and the features.Would highly recommend!

## Details

## About this product

When standing for a full shower feels tiring or unsteady, this wall-mounted seat gives you a secure place to sit so you can wash comfortably without rushing or straining. It is made from rust-free aluminium, so it will not corrode in the damp bathroom environment, and it is lightweight enough that folding it up or down is effortless. The legs give you extra stability, and when you are done, you can fold it flat against the wall to free up space for others. The fixing plate has 6 holes for a solid, secure mount to the wall. 

This seat is designed for people who need to sit while showering due to fatigue, balance concerns, or reduced mobility. The foldable design means it stays out of the way when not needed, making it ideal for shared bathrooms. The lightweight construction makes daily operation simple and easy. Fasteners are not included, so you will need appropriate fixings for your wall type. Installation requires secure fixing through 6 mounting points for safety and support during use.

##### ‼️ Perfekte Unterstützung nach OP - sehr stabil - sicherer Stand und in 2 min aufgebaut ‼️

Reviewed in Germany on 28 November 2025

Colour Name: green Size Name: Flat Seats

Ich habe diesen Duschstuhl für eine 88-jährige Bekannte bestellt, die sich kürzlich einer Wirbelsäulen-Operation unterziehen musste und für die die tägliche Körperpflege, nach der OP zu einer großen Herausforderung wurde.

Der Stuhl hat sich als enorme Erleichterung erwiesen. Der Aufbau ist wirklich kinderleicht und erfordert kein handwerkliches Geschick. Man muss lediglich die vier Füße in die dafür vorgesehenen Steckplätze einstecken, beziehungsweise die Höhe des Stuhls einstellen.

Die Armlehnen können optional montiert werden und werden mit jeweils einer Schraube befestigt und schon ist der Stuhl voll umfänglich einsatzbereit.. Der Aufbau war vor Ort in wenigen Minuten erledigt und die Vorfreude sehr groß. Für die Sicherheit im Bad ist dieser Stuhl hervorragend konzipiert. Die Gummi-Saugnäpfe an den Füßen sorgen dafür, dass der Stuhl auf nassen Fliesen und in der Dusche absolut rutschfest steht. Auch Personen mit etwas höherem Gewicht können sich sicher fühlen, da der Stuhl bis 150 kg Tragkraft zugelassen ist. Meine Bekannte nutzt den Stuhl nicht nur zum Duschen, sondern oft auch einfach, um sich während der Körperpflege im Sitzen auszuruhen. Die Armlehnen bieten zusätzliche Sicherheit beim Hinsetzen und Aufstehen.

Dieser Duschstuhl kann für Senioren eine große Erleichterung im Alltag darstellen. Für mich eine klare Kaufempfehlung für Senioren oder Personen, die nach einer Operation oder bei Bewegungseinschränkungen eine sichere und stabile Hilfe im Bad benötigen! Die Kombination aus einfacher Handhabung, Robustheit und sicherem Stand macht ihn zu einem unverzichtbaren Helfer.
